descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Dezvoltare de software
Mission: 
 Ensure delivered solutions meet business and technical requirements through effective test planning, execution, and automation. Contribute to testing strategies, quality assurance activities, and support Agile project delivery.
 Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain automated test scripts using Playwright .
Prepare and execute functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end tests.
Track, analyze, and report defects.
Coordinate testing activities and provide regular status reports.
Maintain test environments, configurations, and test documentation.
Collaborate with developers, business analysts, and project managers in Agile teams.
 Skills
Experience with Playwright for test automation is a plus.
Knowledge of software testing methodologies and QA best practices.
Experience with Jira, Confluence, Octane/ALM .
Understanding of Information Security principles.
Familiarity with Agile/Scrum environments.
Experience with Git and CI/CD tools is a plus.
 Deliverables
Automated test suites and scripts.
Test plans and execution reports.
Qualification and validation reports.
Test coverage and quality metrics.
 Languages
 French: Professional working proficiency 
 English: Professional working proficiency
